title: TRAI Assesses Mobile Network Quality across parts of Kolkata city, Howrah and Hooghly Districts under Kolkata LSA during the month of July 2026
body_text:
The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has released findings of Independent Drive Test (IDT) conducted across parts of Kolkata city, Howrah and Hooghly Districts under Kolkata LSA, during the month of July 2026, for information of general telecom consumers. The purpose of this drive test is to assess and verify real time quality of mobile network services (both voice & data) provided by Telecom Service Providers (TSPs). During the IDT, TRAI captures performance of TSPs for key Quality of Service (QoS) parameters like Coverage, Call Drop Rate (CDR), Call Setup Success Rate (CSSR), data Download (DL) and Upload (UL) throughput etc., which are then published to inform Consumers and encourage TSPs to improve their services.
These IDTs have been designed to capture on ground mobile network performance of all TSPs across diverse usages environment like cities, hotspots, public transport hubs, etc. In this type of drive testing, live data and voice sessions are established using SIM cards from all TSPs over 2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G networks. Multiple advanced test handsets are used, and the sessions are monitored and analysed in real-time using advanced Software Systems.
TRAI, through its appointed agency, conducted drive tests across City drive – 309.7 KMs, Hotspot locations - 10, Walk Test – 2.8 KMs in Kolkata LSA during 13 th July 2026 to 16 th July 2026 in Kolkata LSA. These tests were conducted under the supervision of the TRAI Regional Office Kolkata. The observations presented in drive test reports represent the performance of the TSPs on the area/ route under test on the day/ time of conducting the drive test.

Key Parameters Assessed
Coverage Gap: Percentage of samples, for which signal strength observed less than the minimum prescribed signal strength for respective technology (2G/ 3G/ 4G/ 5G). Voice Services: Call Setup Success Rate (CSSR), Drop Call Rate (DCR), Call Setup Time, Call Silence Rate, Speech Quality (MOS). Call Silence Instance : Number of call silence instance occurred during the calls. Data Services: Download/ Upload Throughput, Latency, Jitter, Packet Drop Rate
The overall mobile network performance in parts of Kolkata city, Howrah and Hooghly Districts under Kolkata LSA for the key parameters has been summarised below: -
a) Coverage Gap - The signal strength observed during voice testing on the city drive test route in auto-selection mode (5G/4G/3G/2G), measured as the number of samples having poor signal strength out of the total samples collected, was 122 / 65638 for Airtel , 3904 / 64760 for BSNL , 181 / 65280 for RJIL and 401 / 65726 for VIL . Details of the coverage gaps have been provided in the map Annexed .
b) Dropped Calls - Dropped calls, measured as the number of dropped calls out of the number of successfully established calls, were 1/ 466 for Airtel , 15 / 483 for BSNL , 0 / 468 for RJIL and 2 / 462 for VIL . Details of the dropped call locations have been provided in the map A nnexed .
c) Call Silence Instance - Call silence instances, measured as the total number of silence instances observed for > 3 seconds out of the total calls established, were 6 / 454 for Airtel , 36 / 458 for BSNL , 5 / 455 for RJIL and 39 / 467 for VIL . Details of the call silence instance locations have been provided in the map Annexed .
d) Data Download and Upload Throughput :
i) Data Download performance (Overall) : Average download speed was observed as 255.13  Mbps for Airtel (5G/4G) , 7.98 Mbps for BSNL (4G/2G) , 297.95 Mbps for RJIL (5G/4G) and 49.06 Mbps for VIL (4G/2G) . Detail of Download throughput has been provided in the map Annexed.
ii) Data Upload performance (Overall) : Average upload speed was observed as 45.64 Mbps for Airtel (5G/4G) , 4.35 Mbps for BSNL (4G/ 2G) , 38.63 Mbps for RJIL (5G/4G) and 12.31 Mbps for VIL (4G/2G) . Detail of Upload throughput has been provided in the map Annexed.
Locations of Dropped Calls and Call Silence instances can be seen by clicking red dot on the map Annexed.
Details of drive test route and area covered during the IDT is as under: -
a) City - The areas covered in the city drive are Adisaptagram, Chinsurah, Bhadreswar, Serampore, Uttarpara, Bally, Howrah, Shibpur, Radhadasi, Nalpur, Chengail, Panchla, Alampur, Santragachi, Old Jagacha, Belgachia, Bhatta Nagar, Dankuni, Bankagachha and Singur etc.
b) Hotspot - The hot spot locations, capturing stationary user experience, are (i) Bandel Thermal Power Station (BTPS) - Masterpara - Tribeni – Bandapara; (ii) Dhulagarh Crossing - Dhulagori - Howrah - Jala Dhulagiri; (iii) Hooghly Cochin Shipyard Limited - 131/1 Satyen Bose Rd - Nazirganj – Howrah; (iv) Hooghly Institute of Technology - Vivekananda Rd - Chinsurah R S – Chinsurah; (v) Hooghly Mohsin College - Bhanumati Road - P.O. Chinsurah; (vi) Imambara District Hospital - Hospital Road - Naihati – Chinsurah; (vii) Nabanna State Secretariat - HRBC Building - 325 Sarat Chatterjee Rd – Shibpur; (viii) Serampore Head Post Office - Panchu Gopal Bhaduri Sarani - Tin Bazar – Serampore; (ix) Sheoraphuli Ferry Ghat - Sarat Chandra Mukherjee Rd - Sheoraphuli – Baidyabati; (x) Uluberia Subdivision Court - Orisha Trunk Rd - Kalibari - Uluberia – Howrah.
c) Walk Test - The Walk tests conducted during 13 th to 14 th July 2026, are (i) Howrah Station New Complex - Howrah Railway Station; (ii) Santragachi Jn. - Santragachi Station Rd - Santragachi – Howrah; (iii) Uluberia Super Spacility Hospital - Bazarpara - Uluberia – Howrah, , capturing mobile network behaviour in crowded pedestrian environments.
The findings of this IDT report have been shared with respective TSPs for taking further necessary action at their end. Detailed reports of IDT are made available on the TRAI website at www.trai.gov.in.
